description: Committed reference generations for the coding-agent eval harness. known-good/ holds one verified solution per task (the deterministic CI control). known-bad/ holds deliberately wrong generations used by the self-test: each must fail at the stage recorded below.

featureserver-count.reason: destructures the numeric queryFeatureCount() result as an envelope object

ogc-features-query.reason: hallucinates result.items instead of the Result contract's features array

wfs-query.reason: queries a feature type the server does not publish

geocode-address.reason: targets an unpublished locator; the request 404s

cli-count.reason: adds a where clause that filters everything out, so the count is wrong
